motds.body: Extract. Survive. Repeat! Choose a Sprite before each match for a Sprite Power, and rescue more during a match to build your Collection. Take movement to new levels with the Seven Slider, unleash explosive rounds with the Chaos Exploder Rifle, and more!
motds.title: Fortnite: Runners Is Here!

motds.body: Equip a Sprite before each match for a unique Sprite Power, like threat tracking or shield regeneration. Level them up through eliminations, opening chests, and reviving teammates for stronger effects, and secure new Sprites at Extraction Sites to build your Collection!
motds.title: Secure the Win With Sprites!

motds.body: Get the drop on opponents with the Seven Slider, which unlocks high-speed slides with slow-motion and increased accuracy when aiming while sliding. Master new weapons like the Chaos Exploder Rifle with rounds that detonate on contact, the triple-barreled Extending Focus Shotgun for up close eliminations, and more!
motds.title: Gear Up Like a Runner!

motds.body: The unstoppable hitman has joined the fight. Take down enemies with John Wick’s signature precision and style. Battle Pass owners can unlock the John Wick Outfit and rescue his dog in Battle Royale to earn a Sidekick!
motds.title: Baba Yaga Hits the Scene

motds.body: Mastery Monday runs until 9:00 AM ET on Tuesday. Find Legendary and Mythic Sprites more often, earn double Sprite Dust, and level up Sprites twice as fast. Stellar Sprites await your Collection!
motds.title: Mastery Monday Live Now

messages.body: Commanders, we've moved the Save the World message of the day to appear when you first log into Fortnite!
messages.title: Message of the day update
